about_short_description.short_description: Alchemy creates and implements clinical pharmacy programs and deploys technology products that use the pharmacy.

product.name: In-house Pharmacy Program
product.description: A service to build, deploy, and operate pharmacies within clinics, enabling direct medication dispensing and control over pharmacy operations.

product.name: Clinical Pharmacy Programs
product.description: Design and implementation of clinical programs that integrate pharmacy services to find, link, treat, and retain patients in care, especially for HIV and Hepatitis C.

product.name: Digital Pharmacy Platform
product.description: A digital infrastructure platform that supports pharmacy operations, patient communication, compliance, and real-time performance monitoring.

product.name: Mobile Clinic Program
product.description: A mobile health service that conducts targeted testing and treatment initiation for HIV and Hepatitis C in community settings.

product.name: Prescription Home Delivery Program
product.description: A service enabling compliant home delivery of medications to patients, including prescription check-in, patient consent, and driver drop-off tracking.
